agent_execution_records_payload_check.name: agent_execution_records_payload_check
agent_execution_records_payload_check.value:
(
        ("agent_execution_records"."record_type" = 'step_telemetry' AND "agent_execution_records"."telemetry_data" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_execution_records"."summary_data" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("agent_execution_records"."record_type" = 'execution_summary' AND "agent_execution_records"."summary_data" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_execution_records"."telemetry_data" IS NULL)
      )

execution_steps_select_policy.name: execution_steps_select_policy
execution_steps_select_policy.using:
EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "workflow_executions"
    WHERE "workflow_executions"."id" = "execution_steps"."execution_id"
    AND "workflow_executions".tenant_id = get_tenant_id()
  )

marketplace_listings_listing_type_bindin.name: marketplace_listings_listing_type_binding_check
marketplace_listings_listing_type_bindin.value:
(
        "marketplace_listings"."listing_type" = 'workflow'
        AND "marketplace_listings"."workflow_version_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "marketplace_listings"."plugin_db_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "marketplace_listings"."listing_type" = 'plugin'
        AND "marketplace_listings"."plugin_db_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "marketplace_listings"."workflow_version_id" IS NULL
      )

chk_memory_sessions_fk.name: chk_memory_sessions_fk
chk_memory_sessions_fk.value: execution_id IS NOT NULL OR agent_conversation_id IS NOT NULL
